mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 66 degrees near the Verona Area High School. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 60 degrees with rain predicted. If you look to the northwest near the high school at 7:40 PM, you can spot the space station traveling toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot for a five minute show.

City road maintenance begins September 23 with chip sealing on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and the Liberty Business Park, which will involve lane closures. Also, the Plan Commission meets October 5 to discuss various development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero and several certified survey maps.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today, you can enjoy the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli, the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at several local spots including Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, Bike the Barns takes place tomorrow at Badger Prairie County Park.

In our weekly look at public safety, on September 5, an officer investigated a series of reports involving cheese slices left on vehicle windshields throughout the area, which was identified as a social media trend.
The Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM for all your favorites, though please note that the flavor of the day is currently unavailable due to the ongoing store remodel.
